scenes.title: TALLEST WAVE EVER
vo: The tallest wave on record didn't hit a beach.

scenes.title: LEVEL 1
vo: This is Lituya Bay in Alaska, a narrow inlet walled in by steep mountains.

scenes.title: LEVEL 2
vo: On July ninth, nineteen fifty-eight, a powerful earthquake struck along the Fairweather fault.

scenes.title: LEVEL 3
vo: It shook a huge chunk of cliff loose at the head of the bay.
Imagine dropping a brick into a full bathtub.
The water has nowhere to go, except up.

scenes.title: LEVEL 4
vo: The water surged up the opposite slope and stripped the forest away, as high as one thousand seven hundred twenty feet.
That's about five hundred twenty-four meters.

scenes.title: BONUS
vo: In places, it tore through the forest three thousand six hundred feet inland.
